script: The CIA secretly dosed its own citizens with LSD for twenty years, and called it national security. Starting in 1953, the agency ran a program to test mind control, giving hallucinogenic drugs to people who never agreed to it. Some were CIA employees. Some were hospital patients. Some were ordinary people at bars who never even knew they had been drugged. Officials wanted to know if they could erase a person's memory, or force someone to follow orders against their own will. Records show at least one man died after being secretly dosed without his knowledge, thrown from a hotel window. In 1973, officials ordered nearly every document destroyed, trying to erase the entire program from history. A handful of surviving papers leaked years later, and the public learned the truth. The CIA secretly dosed its own citizens for twenty years, and almost erased it completely.

title: The CIA Secretly Dosed Its Own Citizens With LSD for Twenty Years
description:
Starting in 1953, the CIA's MKUltra program gave hallucinogenic drugs to people who never agreed to it, including ordinary citizens who never knew. In 1973, officials tried to destroy nearly every record of it.

Did you know a program like this actually ran for two decades? Let me know in the comments.
